findings.issue_text: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:5 — When run from the repository root, ENV_FILE="../.env" resolves to the parent directory’s .env, causing the script to update or create the wrong file instead of the project .env.

goldens.comment: The updateManyByCredentialId call uses an empty data object, which prevents Prisma's @updatedAt decorator from updating the updatedAt timestamp. This results in inaccurate cache status tracking, as the timestamp isn't updated when the cache is refreshed. To fix this, explicitly set the updatedAt field.
logic: macOS-specific sed syntax with empty string after -i flag will fail on Linux systems

Throwing a generic Error for authentication failures results in a 500 response in tRPC. Instead, it should return a structured TRPCError with an appropriate code, such as FORBIDDEN, to accurately reflect the error type.
Date is formatted with hardcoded 'en-US' locale instead of using the user's locale from useLocale, which can lead to incorrect date representation for users in different locales.

adjudication_records.issue_text: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:5 — When run from the repository root, ENV_FILE="../.env" resolves to the parent directory’s .env, causing the script to update or create the wrong file instead of the project .env.

adjudication.rationale: The script at scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh sets ENV_FILE="../.env" on line 5. When the script is executed from the repository root (which is common), this relative path would resolve to the parent directory of the repository, not the project's .env file. The script then modifies this file (lines 58-64), potentially creating or updating the wrong .env file. This is a real bug in the newly added script.
